title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: booking the correction fee for a correction that required the originals back
content:
## Scope of application

Under the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, a correction executed after issuance on a document type whose tier requires the originals to be returned before an issued document is corrected is charged exactly one correction fee row, tied to the correction request it charges.

This entry covers only corrections the documentation party asks for to change what it supplied. A correction caused by the line's own keying error is outside it: that correction stays uncharged under the product's correction rules, and no row is booked here.

## Entry condition

Before the fee is booked, the correction it charges must already stand on the document, which on such a tier is possible only once every outstanding original has been lodged back with the line under bol_ correction.

In plain terms, the reference at the end of that clause is to the product's correction rules for issued documents. Only a correction that already stands on the document is charged; where this condition is unmet, the fee is not booked.

## Business effect

One call adds one correction fee charge to the documentation account of the document, tied to the correction request it charges and dated the current day, and raises the documentation charges due on the document by the amount booked. The customer then sees the correction fee in the documentation history and in the charges due.

## How it is invoked

charge_correction_fee_18211c73 is an internal tool of the documentation desk: it must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document charged, as returned by the transport document lookup | Id text |
| booking_id | Reference number of the booking the document covers, as shown on the transport document record and returned by the booking lookup | Id text |
| request_id | Reference number of the correction request this fee charges, as returned by the documentation service request lookup | Id text |
| amount_usd | The fee booked, in USD | Written to 2 decimal places, no currency sign |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new documentation charge reference (an opaque text id beginning "bcf_"), the transport document reference, the correction request charged, the amount booked in USD with 2 decimal places and the documentation charges now due. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** May a second correction fee row be booked for the same correction request? **Answer:** No; the correction is charged exactly one correction fee row, tied to its request.
- **Question:** The correction request is on file but the correction has not yet been applied to the document. **Answer:** The correction does not yet stand on the document, so the fee is not booked.
- **Question:** The correction was needed because the line keyed the shipping instructions wrongly. **Answer:** It is outside this entry; no row is booked here.
